messages:
mike.p: Hey team, my March paycheck is short $210. I moved from NY -> NH on 2026-02-28, updated the HR portal on 3/1, but my stub for PR-2026-03-31-9102 shows NY state withholding. Can someone confirm why?

olivia.hr: @rene.payroll can you pull PR-2026-03-31-9102 and check which residence/state code was applied? Mike, did you file any new state withholding form or just updated the address and NH license?

mike.p: Just updated address and uploaded NH license on 3/1. Didn't submit a new state W-4. NH has no income tax so I expected $0 state withholding.

payroll-bot: PR-2026-03-31-9102 processed 2026-03-31 07:58 UTC. Employee payroll state on file: NY. (automated note)

rene.payroll: Looks like HRIS change didn't sync before cutoff. I'll open vendor ticket to request reversal of NY withholding and ask about off-cycle net correction. @anna.finance FYI for GL treatment.

anna.finance: If vendor issues a refund we'll post reversing entry and do an off-cycle top-up. If not, we'll reconcile with a W-2c later but prefer immediate fix. Need gross and NY withheld amount.

mike.p: Gross was $4,200. NY withheld $210. Stub screenshot uploaded to portal. Bank last4: 2143.

rene.payroll: Ticket PAY-4744 created. Requesting expedited refund and an off-cycle deposit of +$210 net if vendor approves. Also flagged employee record to force NH state for next runs.

olivia.hr: Added relocation confirmation and NH ID to PAY-4744. Also creating internal ops ticket to review timing of HRIS->vendor sync around month-end moves.

payroll-bot: PAY-4744 logged. SLA 72 hours. Next update expected 2026-04-03 15:00 UTC.

rene.payroll: Will update here when vendor responds. If vendor declines, plan is to reverse in next payroll and coordinate with finance for adjusting entries.

mike.p: Thanks 1 appreciate it. Let me know if you need anything else.
